prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1476; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle guarding and reduced range of motion in the cervical and lumbar spine. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the symptoms reported. Some objective findings on examination, including palpable paraspinal tenderness and restricted motion, support the clinical diagnosis of cervical and lumbar strain. Other neurological and orthopedic tests performed during the evaluation were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the neck or back is known. The patient completed 25 visits of conservative care, including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. Progress has been gradual, and the course of treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of strain. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no duplicated or repeated charges. Ongoing management includes continued home exercise and reassessment at the next scheduled follow-up.
